priority_1.workout_details: 15-minute progressive warm-up ending with 3x 30-sec high-cadence efforts. Main Set: 5 x 3 minutes at 285-310 Watts (Zone 5), with 3 minutes of easy spin recovery between intervals. 10-minute cool-down.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority today because your fresh state (TSB +3.4) and empty sleep notes present a perfect opportunity to target your primary cycling goal of 5-minute power. This high-intensity workout utilizes the pyramidal 70/30 split appropriately.

priority_2.workout_details: 10-minute warm-up jog. Main Set: 3 x 1 mile at goal 5km pace (approx. 4:15-4:30/km based on historical efficiency) with 2 minutes of walking/jogging recovery between reps. 5-minute cool-down.
priority_2.reason: An excellent alternative targeting running economy and stride quality. Because running places higher orthopedic stress, this is ranked second, but is highly beneficial for your 5km target distance.

priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 mins mobility. Main lifts: 1) Barbell Back Squats: 4 sets x 5 reps (approx. 75-80kg), focus on explosive hip drive. 2) Heavy Sandbag Clean & Carry: 3 sets x 30 meters. 3) Push-ups & Kettlebell Row superset: 3 sets x 10 reps. Core: Hanging Leg Raises 3 x max reps.
priority_3.reason: If weather or schedule limits outdoor training, building high torque in the lower body directly supports cycling torque and running power. This maintains structural integrity for the upcoming CTL ramp.
